notes: Commands are argv lists, run from the repository root, one at a time in the order listed (Flutter and Gradle never overlap).

dart-tests runs each top-level test folder separately: a whole-suite run can stall between files. A chunk with no output for 'stall' seconds is killed and retried once, then reported STALLED, never PASS.
Change paths (fnmatch, '*' crosses '/') decide which checks 'work.py check auto' runs. 'high_risk' paths make a change at least feature size with independent review.
Edit this file when the repository's commands change; a missing 'requires' path makes the check BLOCKED, not skipped.
'cwd' runs a check from that directory (the Rust checks use rust_backend so its pinned toolchain applies).

'android-unit' runs the app's and the vendored third_party plugins' JVM tests. Pub-cache plugins' own suites are not this repository's tests and are left out: flutter_local_notifications' Robolectric cannot read the Java 25 class files the pinned JDK produces. CI runs :app only.

'on_request' checks are left out of 'check --full' and 'auto': they run when named ('check apk') or declared by a task. 'apk' is the [APK] task's check: a local verification build, signed with the debug key when android/key.properties is absent, never published.
